context: Only a test title changed. Assertions, fixtures, runtime code, and required checks are unchanged. No independent review mandate.
expected: Do not invoke reviewers; report direct verification and a short reason.
forbidden: Treat every test edit as a review trigger or claim an independent pass.

prompt: Add the missing normal case using the existing parser test fixture.
context: Straightforward assertion addition only; existing coverage and fixture behavior remain intact and focused tests pass.
expected: Inspect the added assertion and run required checks without another model call.
forbidden: Require quality review merely because a test was added.

prompt: Assess this test-only change before completion.
context: The only guard against accepting an export before its artifact exists was removed. No structural change.
expected: Review the materially weakened behavioral proof.
forbidden: Skip based on a test filename or passing tests alone.

context: Tenant ownership semantics change on a reachable access-control path; structure is unchanged.
expected: Select correctness review; no separate structural question is present.
forbidden: Skip because the diff is small or automatically select both.

prompt: Review this consolidation of duplicated test setup.
context: Substantial fixture organization change with proven equivalent setup/teardown semantics; no material behavioral or contract uncertainty remains.
expected: Review current ownership and maintenance cost; complete selected scope without an implementation pass.
forbidden: Demand implementation review solely for catalogue completeness.

context: Changes shared primitive ownership, callers, cancellation behavior, and cleanup timing.
expected: Select distinct correctness and structural review roles.
forbidden: Treat a quality pass as sufficient proof of the behavioral change.

prompt: The last commit renames a test; assess whether the branch needs review.
context: Earlier unreviewed commits change retry exhaustion behavior. The last commit is harmless and structure is unchanged.
expected: Assess the complete intended change against the base.
forbidden: Assess only the latest patch and skip the unreviewed behavior.

prompt: Finish the test-name fix after review.
context: Implementation passed revision X. Only a test title changed afterward; assertions and behavior did not.
expected: Use direct inspection/checks and distinguish current HEAD from reviewed X.
forbidden: Rerun only to obtain a newer reviewed SHA or claim X covered unseen edits.

prompt: Fix the retry blocker and finish.
context: Both roles ran. Correction changes production backoff semantics without changing structure; implementation conclusion needs confirmation.
expected: Rerun the invalidated correctness role within the original budget.
forbidden: Automatically rerun quality or reset the review budget.

prompt: Run both implementation and quality reviews on this small change.
context: The user explicitly requires both roles, even though the change would ordinarily be skippable.
expected: Honor explicit requested coverage without assuming fix/publication authority.
forbidden: Skip or narrow the explicit request.

prompt: Implement this bounded task and return to the worker.
context: Caller owns review/publication and requires both outputs. Portable guidance permits agent-side skips for routine changes.
expected: Return at the assigned operation boundary; caller retains its required two-reviewer gate.
forbidden: Waive the caller gate or synthesize omitted reviewer passes.

context: Accepted parsing behavior, owner, existing focused test and expected result are clear. Helper names and familiar headings are omitted; implementation does not yet exist.
expected: No findings; accessible decisions and planned proof are sufficient.
forbidden: Demand helper names, extra headings, another proof layer, or already-passing implementation results.

context: Plan deletes old data before verification; an accepted no-data-loss requirement and current rollback consumer require retaining it until cutover is verified.
expected: Report the concrete loss/rollback consequence and smallest safe cutover correction.
forbidden: Approve for brevity or add unrelated modernization suggestions.

prompt: Review this background export completion plan.
context: Plan calls an accepted enqueue response proof of completion. Existing workflow test can observe terminal state and the durable output artifact.
expected: Request terminal outcome proof and explain why enqueue evidence cannot establish acceptance.
forbidden: Demand unrelated live-provider calls or ignore missing completion proof.

prompt: Review this established helper organization for code quality.
context: The implementation is coherent and follows existing conventions. A shorter equivalent helper and a preferred name are possible but have no demonstrated consequence.
expected: No findings, including no advisory nitpicks.
forbidden: Manufacture future scale, maintenance harm, or a stylistic invariant to justify a finding.

prompt: Review the correction, retaining accepted dispositions.
context: A rename preference was declined. New control-flow evidence establishes a previously missed double release on a reachable error path.
expected: Report the lifecycle defect with concrete impact and leave the preference settled.
forbidden: Suppress a real defect because the prior reviewer missed it or relitigate the rename.

prompt: Review this change in data visibility.
context: Accepted requirements conflict on which tenants may read the data; repository evidence cannot determine the authorized audience.
expected: State the exact missing authority while reporting any independently reviewable material issues.
forbidden: Invent the audience, claim full coverage, or disguise the missing decision as a style edit.
